messages.subject: Error when running specprop
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

For those of you that have been following my posts, my advisor and I have made some good progress analysing our calls.
However, as we're trying to extract more information from the data, we've run into a slight problem with one argument.

We've successfully defined the parameters:

F1 = 0
f2 = 10000
wlfil = 2048
f1 = 0.3
f2 = 3

As well as:

meanspectrum<-meanspec(FSong,from=PULSES$s.start[1],to=PULSES$s.start[nbpulses],wl=wlFFT,ovlp=over,plot=FALSE)

(FSong being our filtered object, and PULSES being the object after being run through timer.)
Which returns this error:

Error in if (flim[1] < 0 || flim[2] > fhz/2) stop("'flim' should range between 0 and f/2") :
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

We're a bit confused with this error, as the range should be sufficient to include f/2, correct? This worked in a previous version of Seewave, but I don't know what argument could have been changed on its way to 3.2.2 to return this.

Thanks for any help you may have!

Alex

messages.subject: Window correction factors.
messages.body_plain:
Seewave is a valuable resource, thank you for your efforts.

We have searched code and cannot find your treatment for tapered window correction factors ( Hann, Hamming, triangular, etc) during FFT use.
These processing window applications effects the resulting estimated amplitudes.

We have interest in broadband but there should be both broadband and narrowband (tonal content) processing options.

messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Window correction factors.
messages.body_plain:
It is true that I did not include correction factors for tapered windows.
I will add them to the next release of seewave.
Thanks for alerting me on this.
Best
Jerome
